newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - DAILY VARIETY - AUG 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - DAILY VARIETY - AUG 8.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's Daily Variety:
* CBS Entertainment chief Leslie Moonves was named president of CBS Television Thursday, a move that prompted the resignation of CBS TV Network president James Warner.
* At least five returning primetime series will move from one network to another this fall.
* Los Angeles' KTLA-TV has opted not to renew the contract of news director David Goldberg for a second year, resulting in Goldberg's permanent departure from the Tribune station.
* Universal Studios has tapped MTV Networks veteran Tony Garland to head a new division dedicated to launching Universal-branded channels around the world.
* Bruce Beresford, who last directed the drama "Paradise Road," will next step behind the camera for Paramount Pictures' thriller "Double Jeopardy" for producer Leonard Goldberg, sources said.
* Denise Gurin has been tapped VP of film and head film buyer of Knoxville, Tenn.-based Regal Cinemas.
